name: Petitioner's Chamber
summary: The Petitioner's Chamber, also known as the Hall of Petitioners, is an antechamber situated just off the main entrance ramp of Stormwind Keep. It serves as an official waiting room for nobility, church dignitaries, and visiting subjects seeking an audience with the crown. Those lingering here often pass the hours mingling, drinking, or waiting upon the regent's pleasure.

sections.title: A Room of Waiting and Influence
sections.body: Found immediately to the right upon ascending into Stormwind Keep, the Petitioner's Chamber is where matters of state meet everyday bureaucracy. Nobles such as Count Remington Ridgewell and high-ranking clergy like Bishop DeLavey pass their time in these halls while waiting for an audience with the boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Behind the polished veneer of courtly etiquette, it is an ideal corner of the castle for gossip, quiet lobbying, and discerning who truly holds influence within the realm.

faq.q: Where is the Petitioner's Chamber located?
faq.answer: The chamber is located inside Stormwind Keep. As soon as you ascend the grand entrance ramp into the keep, it is the first room directly on your right.

The room is frequented by petitioners, court attendees, and nobles seeking the ear of the throne, including figures like Count Remington Ridgewell, Caledra Dawnbreeze, and Bishop DeLavey of the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why is it also called the Hall of Petitioners?
faq.answer: Its formal function is to host subjects who have submitted formal petitions to the crown. Visitors must wait here until the regent, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, or the royal council grants them admittance to the throne room.

faq.q: What happens here during city quests?
faq.answer: The chamber is primarily visited when delivering goods or speaking with nobles and clergy stationed within the keep, such as running errands to supply refined drinks like port for thirsty aristocrats waiting on court business.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists, this chamber represents the administrative bottleneck of Stormwind, where domestic appeals, church affairs, and noble requests await the royal council's scarce attention.
With Bishop DeLavey often stationed in this antechamber, the room serves as an intersection between the Holy Light's administrative hierarchy and the royal court.
